_comment: Harness capability matrix. The installer subtracts a forge skill from a harness
when that harness already ships the same CAPABILITY natively.
coverage 'full'    -> skill is skipped by default for that harness.
coverage 'partial' -> skill is installed by default; --strict-native also skips it.
Keep this honest. A wrong 'full' silently removes a capability from a harness.

capabilities.requirements-interview: Interrogate an ambiguous ask until the requirement is unambiguous.
capabilities.ramble-capture: Turn a long unstructured or dictated brief into a verified understanding.
capabilities.acceptance-criteria: Write observable done criteria that outlive the session.
capabilities.design-gate: Block implementation until a design artifact is approved.
capabilities.primary-source-research: Investigate against first-party sources and cite every claim.
capabilities.adversarial-review: Cross-examine an in-flight decision from a fresh context.
capabilities.task-decomposition: Break work into ordered, individually testable tasks.
capabilities.spec-authoring: Write a structured specification before implementation.
capabilities.intent-engineering: Decompose a vague goal into directives and a task graph.
capabilities.swarm-execution: Run a multi-agent plan with oversight and adversarial checks.
capabilities.tdd: Write the failing test before the implementation.
capabilities.code-review: Audit a diff for correctness, security, performance, readability.
capabilities.completion-evidence: Refuse completion claims that lack fresh verification output.
capabilities.quality-bar: Record the project's quality thresholds and detect them being lowered.
capabilities.scope-drift: Compare a diff against its stated intent and flag what grew.
capabilities.verification-rubrics: Run deterministic static checks plus blinded judge rubrics.
capabilities.simplification: Strip boilerplate, filler, and dead abstraction.
capabilities.cognitive-calibration: Profile how this specific human reads, and adapt output to it.
capabilities.reader-simulation: Simulate real readers to find where a draft loses them.
capabilities.discernment-prompts: Hand the human questions that help them audit the output.
capabilities.voice-profiling: Extract a human's authentic writing cadence and style markers.
capabilities.technical-copy: Draft technical prose in a chosen voice.
capabilities.chart-authoring: Design charts, dashboards, and data visualisations.
capabilities.image-generation: Generate technical diagrams and visual assets.
capabilities.docs-authoring: Scaffold SDLC docs and compile them into readable portals.
capabilities.knowledge-catalog: Maintain a durable progressive-disclosure codebase memory.
capabilities.oss-compliance: Audit licensing headers and scrub internal references.
capabilities.alignment-distillation: Distil transcript learnings into a bounded AGENTS.md.
capabilities.skill-sync: Manage skill installation across agent runtimes.

task-decomposition.note: Plan mode produces an approved plan for the current turn. It does not persist an ordered task graph with per-task checkpoints, which is what the plan skill writes to disk.

code-review.note: The built-in reviews a GitHub pull request. The review skill runs a five-axis audit over an arbitrary working diff, with no PR required.
